title: Dr. Richard Southee:
title_short: Dr. Richard Southee · Three Times as Likely
headline: CASS found that a client with a case manager is almost three times as likely to have a positive outcome. There isn't one solution to homelessness; there are a thousand.
story: The data: with a case manager, a client's odds of a positive outcome go up almost three times.
He writes policy thinking about the clients he worked with. And if you want to complain, he's the guy to complain to.
Not one solution to homelessness, but a thousand. Every person needs a different one.
